note: Rendered with intro-export.html on a teammate's laptop; narration made with Google Gemini text-to-speech and mixed in by Claude. Beats tell the app when to send each line to a screen reader.

beats.speak: Welcome. This soft pulse is home. Press S to skip.
Walk with the arrow keys, or W A S D.
More rain plays louder and brighter.
Press 6 to hear all five layers as one chord.
Press T to hear twenty years ago. Now, your turn.
